mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_post_analysis (id, post_id, summary, similar_post_ids, risk_level, risk_categories, confidence, evidence_json, reasoning, has_conflict, conflict_type, retry_count, handler_action, model_version, latency_ms, token_cost) VALUES (#{a.id}, #{a.postId}, #{a.summary}, #{a.similarPostIds}, #{a.riskLevel}, #{a.riskCategories}, #{a.confidence}, #{a.evidenceJson}, #{a.reasoning}, #{a.hasConflict}, #{a.conflictType}, #{a.retryCount}, #{a.handlerAction}, #{a.modelVersion}, #{a.latencyMs}, #{a.tokenCost}) ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, similar_post_ids = EXCLUDED.similar_post_ids, risk_level = EXCLUDED.risk_level, risk_categories = EXCLUDED.risk_categories, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, evidence_json = EXCLUDED.evidence_json, reasoning = EXCLUDED.reasoning, has_conflict = EXCLUDED.has_conflict, conflict_type = EXCLUDED.conflict_type, retry_count = EXCLUDED.retry_count, model_version = EXCLUDED.model_version, latency_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_ms, token_cost = EXCLUDED.token_cost
INSERT INTO tb_post_analysis (id, post_id, handler_action) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{handlerAction}) ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET handler_action = EXCLUDED.handler_action
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, summary, similar_post_ids, risk_level, risk_categories, confidence, evidence_json, reasoning, has_conflict, conflict_type, retry_count, handler_action, model_version, latency_ms, token_cost, create_time FROM tb_post_analysis WHERE post_id = #{postId} LIMIT 1
